entries.title: Titus 1:1
segments: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ (according to [the] faith of God's elect, in the acknowledging of [the] truth which is according to godliness

entries.title: Titus 1:2
segments: on hope of eternal life, which God, who cannot lie, promised before [the] eternal times,

entries.title: Titus 1:3
segments: but revealed in its own times in a proclamation of His word, with which I was entrusted by [the] command of God our Savior,)

entries.title: Titus 1:4
segments: to Titus, a true child according to [our] common faith. Grace mercy and peace from God [the] Father and [the] Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.

entries.title: Titus 1:5
segments: For this cause I left you in Crete, that you should set in order the things that are lacking and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed you,

entries.title: Titus 1:6
segments: if anyone is blameless, husband of one wife, having believing children, not accused of loose behavior, or disobedient.

entries.title: Titus 1:7
segments: For an overseer must be blameless, as a steward of God, not self-willed, not full of passion, not given to wine, not quarrelsome, not greedy for ill gain;

entries.title: Titus 1:8
segments: but hospitable, a lover of good, discreet, just, holy, temperate

entries.title: Titus 1:9
segments: holding fast the faithful word according to the doctrine, that he may be able, by sound doctrine, both to exhort and to convict the gainsayers.

entries.title: Titus 1:10
segments: For there are indeed many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of [the] circumcision,

entries.title: Titus 1:11
segments: whose mouth [you] must stop, who subvert whole houses, teaching things not right for the sake of ill gain.

entries.title: Titus 1:12
segments: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, Cretans [are] always liars, evil beasts, lazy gluttons.

entries.title: Titus 1:13
segments: This witness is true; for which cause convict them sharply, so that they may be sound in the faith,

entries.title: Titus 1:14
segments: not giving heed to Jewish myths and commandments of men, turning away from the truth.

entries.title: Titus 1:15
segments: To the pure all things [are] pure. But to those who are defiled and unbelieving nothing [is] pure, but even their mind and conscience is defiled.

entries.title: Titus 1:16
segments: They profess that they know God, but in [their] works they deny [Him], being abominable and disobedient and reprobate to every good work.
